description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateRejectionAPI within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes tests for API methods such as getOne, getValidationRuleForGetOne, update, delete, and getValidationRuleForDelete, primarily focusing on the rejection of candidates via the API.

classes.name: CandidateRejectionAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CandidateRejectionAPI endpoints related to candidate rejection workflows within the recruitment module.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by truncating CandidateHistory table before each test.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the getOne method of CandidateRejectionAPI, expecting it to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Tests the validation rule method for getOne, expecting it to throw a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests the update API method for candidate rejection, using data-driven test cases and setting up mock services.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the testUpdate method, sourced from a YAML file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests the delete API method, expecting a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests the validation rule for delete, expecting a not implemented exception.
